notes.title: Heroes & Redemption is Now Free to Play
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today, we’re sharing an important decision with you.

Due to sustainability issues, we regret to announce that we will no longer be able to actively develop Heroes & Redemption.

As one of our final steps, we’ve decided to make the game completely [u]free to play[/u]. This decision comes from a desire to let the game live on and reach more people — even if we’re no longer able to support or expand it. From now on, the game will be available on Steam at no cost.

To everyone who supported us by purchasing the game: [b]thank you[/b] — sincerely. Your support kept us going.

Farewell,
— [i]Observer Games[/i]

notes.title: ECONOMY REFORGED
notes.notes:
Based on player feedbacks, we have made adjustments to the economy and equipment system to enhance balance and gameplay experience.
[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bosses at the end of levels now gives Soul Shards upon defeat. 
(Golem:15 | Demon:20 | Frozen Golem:25 | Beholder:30 | Drond:20 | Drund:20)
[*]Adjusted the conversion cost for Soul Shards. (10000 ▶ 6666)
[*]Adjusted the amount of Soul Shards obtained from certain altars. (2nd Wave Basic(3 ▶ 5) | 2nd Wave Obelisk(5 ▶ 7) | 2nd Wave Blacksmith(7 ▶ 9))
[*]All equipments are now unlockable in the game.
[list]
[*]Bosses now drop a chest upon defeat, which unlocks 3 to 6 equipments, depending on luck.
[*]Once unlocked, these equipments can be purchased from the Blacksmith.
[*]Made changes to the Bestiary screen to display the drop rates of equipments for each boss.
[*]Equipments previously purchased will be immediately usable after unlocking and do not need to be repurchased.
[*]If you unequip currently equipped armors, you will need to unlock them again before re-equipping.
[/list][*]Reduced the price of all armors to [b]one-third[/b] of their original cost.
[*]Adjusted the prices of some rings.
[list]
[*]Revive Ring [14 ▶ 5]
[*]Ring of Dwarf Warrior [24 ▶ 10]

[*]Ring of Double Punishment [34 ▶ 16]
[*]Fateweaver's Ring [36 ▶ 17]
[*]Ring of Soul Harvest [48 ▶ 23]

[*]Ring of Scarred Soul [82 ▶ 37]
[/list][*]Adjusted the prices of some empowerments.

[*]Added an icon next to the difficulty icon in the level selection UI to indicate increased gold rewards.
[*]Added different colors for emphasis to certain words in equipment descriptions.
[*]Made improvements to armor set descriptions and their tier-based attributes for better clarity.
[/list]
[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue on the Dor'galor's Trials where the game would not progress.

[*]Fixed the collider for the anvil at the Blacksmith Altar.

29 new achievements.
[spoiler]Ring Bearer, Sacred Rune, Mythic Runes, Empowered!, Blade Whisperer, Woodland Scout, Voidcaller, Tome of Regret, Book of Requiem, Poisonous Mist, Aqua: Stream, Novice Challenger, Skilled Adventurer, Trial Master, Arena Conqueror, Legend of the Trials, Filthy Survivor, Sludge Slayer, Mire Warrior, Sewer Sentinel, Depth Dominator, Escaped Prisoner, Jailbreaker, Dungeon Warden, Chains of Fate, Liberator of the Forgotten, Elven Lute, Soul Infuser, Magic Anvil.[/spoiler]
[*] [h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Endless Mode.
[*] Some of skill visuals has been changed.
[*] After level 60, the experience required to level up has been reduced.
[*] After maxing out all skills, you receive gold with each level up.
[*] Character stats and prices has been changed.
[*] Armor prices has been changed.
[*] Armor stat has been added to bosses.
[*] You can purchase 10 soul shards with one click.
[*] Performance [b]optimizations[/b].
[/list][/olist]
[h1]🙏 Thank You![/h1]

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you. Your support, suggestions, and participation in testing have been invaluable in making this milestone possible.

[h1]🚀 What’s Next?[/h1]

Version 1.0 is just the beginning! Future updates will continue to focus on your feedback, along with exciting new updates.

If you haven’t played the game yet, now is the perfect time to start!

Thank you for joining us on this journey. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts, see your feedback, and share more ideas together.

It’s time to embark on your adventure!

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES AND NEWS
notes.notes:
Hello heroes, we are here with big news today.
We are pleased to announce the [b]changes [/b]and [b]news [/b]regarding the [b]upcoming [/b]release of [b]Heroes & Redemption 1.0[/b]
You can view some of the updates and changes below.
There may be [u]changes[/u] and [u]additions[/u] in this list in the future.
[olist]
[*] [h1]New Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Poisonous Mist[/b]
As the character moves, it creates acid clouds behind that deal damage to enemies.
[*] [b]Aqua: Stream[/b]
Sprays water in four directions around the character.
[*] [b]Tome of Regret[/b]
A curse has been added to the game. When you acquire this curse, enemies' health, speed and damage increase. Additionally, more enemies spawn.
[/list]
[*] [h1]Empowerment System[/h1]
Empowered versions of each spell have been added to the game. For example, Relentless Strike has three empowerments: Storm Slash, Hellfire Strike and Supreme Strike. Each empowerment adds different attributes to the skill, allowing you to choose the one that best fits your playstyle.

[list] [u]List of all empowerment skills:[/u]
[*] [h3]Sacred Aura[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Divine Vampirism:[/b] Deals damage to nearby enemies and drains their health.
[*] [b]Divine Deceleration:[/b] Deals damage to nearby enemies and slows them down as well.
[*] [b]Ethereal Might:[/b] Deals much more damage to nearby enemies.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Sacred Ring[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Burning Radiance:[/b] Orbs deal additional fire damage to enemies they touch.
[*] [b]Soul Reaver:[/b] Orbs drain health from enemies they touch.
[*] [b]Ring of Aquanis:[/b] Orbs slow down enemies they touch.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Flying Twins [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Arc Spread:[/b] Fires three spells in a conical spread in the direction the character is facing. The number of spells created increases with the skill amount.
[*] [b]Dispersing Twins:[/b] Creates a number of spells equal to the skill amount and spreads them outwards from the character.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Flying Seal[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tempest Seal:[/b] Now it's much, much faster.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Arcane Storm[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Arcane Maelstrom:[/b] The number of rotating circles now increases with skill amount.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Titan's Lightning[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Primordial Thunderfall:[/b] Creates an explosion where it strikes.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Devastation Ritual [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Apocalyptic Ritual:[/b] It reduces its size but spawns under enemies depending on the skill amount.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Demonic Flux[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Eldritch Demonic Flux:[/b] Removes the damage reduction with each bounce.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Comet[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Polyburst:[/b] Shoots 3 projectiles per shot instead of 1
[*] [b]Impactful Comet:[/b] Explodes at the location where it bounces, dealing area damage.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Relentless Strike[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Storm Slash:[/b] Marks the enemies it hits, and they will explode when they take another hit.
[*] [b]Hellfire Strike:[/b] Deals additional fire damage.
[*] [b]Supreme Strike:[/b] Swings much more powerfully.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Conjurrang[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Magnetized Conjurrang:[/b] It is now more powerful and brings experience crystals to the player.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Binding Roots[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Blooming Root:[/b] Blooms a plant beneath the marked enemy that shoots at other enemies.
[*] [b]Wild Grasp:[/b] Instead of slowing down, it now roots all enemies in its area.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Sacred Ritual[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Nova Vortex:[/b] It explodes twice.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Chain Lightning [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Shocking Surge:[/b] Stuns each enemy it hits.
[*] [b]Chain Havoc:[/b] Deals area damage with each hit.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Lightning of Sodnir[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Thunderfield:[/b] The number of thunder bolts now increases with skill amount.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Aqua: Blast[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Aqua: Riptide:[/b] Water now explodes in a larger area and deals more damage
[/list]
[*] [h3]Poisonous Mist[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Noxious Veil:[/b] It's always active.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Aqua: Stream[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tidal Force:[/b] It now sprays water in 8 directions.
[/list]
[/list]
